messages.content:
The issue lies in the `KMeansPlusPlusClusterer` class where an `int` type is incorrectly used for the `sum` variable instead of a `double` type in the `chooseInitialClusters` method. This causes truncation of distances between points to integers, especially problematic when distances are typically less than 1.

Considering the bug report and the code snippet of the constructor of the `KMeansPlusPlusClusterer` class, it seems like the `EMPTY_CLUSTER_STRATEGY` may play a role in addressing the truncation issue in the `chooseInitialClusters` method.

To resolve the truncation issue, it is recommended to review and potentially update the implementation of the `EmptyClusterStrategy` used in the `KMeansPlusPlusClusterer`.

Next, I will suggest specific methods that should be fixed in the code.
```
org.apache.commons.math.stat.clustering.KMeansPlusPlusClusterer.EmptyClusterStrategy
org.apache.commons.math.stat.clustering.KMeansPlusPlusClusterer.KMeansPlusPlusClusterer(java.util.Random, org.apache.commons.math.stat.clustering.KMeansPlusPlusClusterer.EmptyClusterStrategy)
```

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
